description: Figure 16b illustrates the relationship between confidence and accuracy for the MMLU dataset. The x-axis is labeled “Initial Confidence” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.00 to 0.99, with tick labels at intervals of 0.10. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.20. There are three lines displayed on the plot. A green line, marked with triangle-shaped data points, begins at approximately 0.15 and ends at approximately 0.88, exhibiting an overall increasing trend with fluctuations. A purple dashed line, marked with plus-shaped data points, starts at approximately 0.30 and ends at approximately 0.60, showing an initial increase to a peak of approximately 0.65 at an initial confidence of 0.30, followed by a decline. A red solid line, marked with circle-shaped data points, begins at approximately 0.50 and ends at approximately 0.55, with a relatively steady trend and minor fluctuations throughout the range of initial confidence values.
